content.value_statement: Code reviews can miss blockers, regressions, and unverified claims. This skill guides a focused, evidence-based review of the relevant change set.
actual_capabilities: Reviews a designated code change for blockers and regression risks.
Uses a concise findings table with blocker, major, minor, and nit categories.
Checks review evidence and highlights unsupported validation claims.
Focuses re-reviews on fixes made since the previous review.
Separates standards and specification concerns in advanced reviews.
limitations: It does not replace running tests, building the project, or manual product validation.
It reviews only the files and change range available to the assistant.
It does not modify code by default.
Security review is conditional and may require a dedicated security request.

use_cases.title: Review a pull request
use_cases.description: Identify release-blocking defects and regression risks before merging a focused change.

use_cases.title: Check a repair round
use_cases.description: Review only the latest fixes and confirm whether earlier findings were addressed.

use_cases.title: Assess delivery evidence
use_cases.description: Check whether claimed validation has supporting commands, outputs, and scope.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: review my change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current code changes. List blockers and regression risks with evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: A first review of a small change.

prompt_templates.title: Focused pull request review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request against its stated requirements. Prioritize defects that could block merging.
prompt_templates.scenario: A feature or bug-fix pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Re-review a fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Re-review only the changes made since the previous review. Confirm which earlier findings remain.
prompt_templates.scenario: A repair round after review feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced dual-axis review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a standards and specification review of this change. Group findings by axis and include integration risks.

output_examples.input: Review a change that modifies authentication validation.
output: Change summary: Validation now rejects expired sessions.
Blocker: A refresh path still accepts an expired token.
Verification gap: No test result was provided for the refresh path.

output_examples.input: Re-review a bug fix after developer feedback.
output: Change summary: The null check was added in the requested method.
Major: A neighboring caller still passes an invalid value.
Remaining risk: The integration scenario needs a focused test.

best_practices: Provide the change scope, requirements, and relevant test results before requesting review.
Address blocker and major findings before requesting a re-review.
Use a focused re-review after fixes instead of repeating the entire review.
anti_patterns: Do not request a review without identifying the change set or expected behavior.
Do not treat a review as proof that tests and runtime validation succeeded.
Do not use minor style preferences as merge blockers.

faq.question: Does this skill change my code?
faq.answer: No. It reviews changes and reports findings by default.

faq.question: What should I provide for a review?
faq.answer: Provide the change scope, requirements, and available validation evidence.

faq.question: Can it review a pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask it to review the pull request against its requirements and change set.

faq.question: Can it re-review a fix?
faq.answer: Yes. It can focus on changes made since the earlier review.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates reported evidence and identifies validation gaps.

faq.question: Does it perform a security review?
faq.answer: Security checks are used for Full reviews or when you explicitly request security coverage.
